threads.body: Replacement only runs when a callback manager is constructed. A retained `CallbackManager` or `AsyncCallbackManager` used directly through `on_chain_start()` or `on_chat_model_start()` after reinstrumentation still dispatches to the disabled old handler, so new runs produce no telemetry. The existing run-start wrappers do not refresh handlers, and the new tests pass retained managers through `invoke()` rather than exercising direct dispatch. Refresh stale injected handlers before dispatching new-run callbacks, preserving application handlers and the handler lists held by in-flight runs. Add sync/async regression tests that reuse the same manager directly across uninstrumentation and reinstrumentation.

replies.body: Fixed by reusing the handler-refresh logic before dispatch in the existing sync and async run-start wrappers. Retained managers now replace disabled handlers even when used directly, without constructing another manager.
